content: Discord integration patterns in this niche: (1) bots that auto-detect WCL links posted in a channel and reply with a deep link to the analyzer (WoWAnalyzer DiscordBot, Wipefest bot) - zero-effort distribution; (2) native WCL guild-page webhook that auto-posts new reports to a channel; (3) Logs by HLTG: full bot+dashboard, /setguild links a guild, auto-posts rich embeds seconds after each wipe/kill with pull duration/boss health/deaths, plus generates shareable 'kill cards' (roster render w/ class colors + transmog) for Discord/Twitter/Instagram; (4) ParseCard: paste-a-log web tool (not a bot) that generates a shareable Discord image card with 6 auto-generated 'awards' (praise + playful roasts) per fight, adjustable tone (Friendly/Bold/Brutal), Battle.net login to claim a character and unlock weekly credits + cross-fight leaderboards.
